authorization: User asked to speed lens readouts without changing the frozen protocol or losing progress.
scope: Storage and scheduling only. No frozen gen27b runner bytes, numerical code, prompts, cases, layers, precision, lens weights, rank calculations, bootstrap, random seeds, controls, or core results change.
observed_bottleneck: The worker waits on fuse.geesefs persistent-volume operations. Controlled 501-byte append/flush/fsync/close benchmark: median .3755s at 12MB vs .0849s empty and .1189s at 64KB; local-disk control .0001-.0002s. Root disk is not used as the authoritative journal.
concurrent_incident: At 22:35:22Z the existing lens runner caught FileNotFoundError in os.fsync and wrote appendix_deferred.json. Original data and error report retained. This is a storage error, not an experimental-implementation repair.
durability: Every new row retains the original JSON serialization and a successful flush+fsync on the SAME persistent volume. An immutable byte-identical prefix plus append-only chunks of at most 128 rows replace repeated uploads of the growing canonical file. No unflushed batching and no ephemeral-only checkpoint.
completion: Assemble canonical lens_ranks.jsonl from prefix and chunks with one durable atomic replacement at the original completion boundary; keep all chunks. Existing scorecard and completion code executes unchanged.
resume: Validate adapter/spec/model identities and prefix checksum; reject duplicate keys, interior corruption and changed identities; repair only torn final-chunk tail. Consolidation followed by another resume neither drops nor duplicates rows.
verification: Eight CPU tests passed: byte-identical output to original Journal across restart and consolidation/restart; retained immutable prefix; torn-last-tail recovery; identity/duplicate rejection; interior corruption rejection. All old frozen gen27b file hashes must still match existing run_header.json. The fifth test verifies that empty and nonempty real pause files stop, a missing-object read means no pause despite stale stat metadata, and other I/O errors propagate. The sixth test requires cache refresh before a stale-object read. A real persistent-volume test repeatedly ignored the deleted agent flag after directory reload, detected a fresh empty touch before explicit fsync and a fresh text flag, and ignored the removed synthetic test flag. Immutable adapter-descriptor tests tolerate an historical prefix-creator label while rejecting an unreviewed adapter when chunk rows exist.
operations: Safely pause via PAUSE, back up canonical journal and incident, archive transient deferred/battery markers without deleting them, resume through same GPU lock, requeue waiting O-lens after removing only the agent-owned PAUSE token.
performance_claim: Expected storage speedup is supported by small-file benchmark; final wall time is measured after resume and not assumed from GPU utilization.
pause_metadata_fix: After deleting the agent-owned PAUSE, the object-store directory listing repeatedly reported it present while open/read returned ENOENT. Documented GeeseFS cache invalidation briefly cleared stat state but the stale listing recurred. Scheduling and stop-boundary guards now determine existence by opening/reading one byte: any actual file, including empty, pauses; only FileNotFoundError means absent, and other errors stop/escalate. SIGINT/SIGTERM STOP handling remains unchanged. This changes control-plane storage checks only; no frozen gen27b or O-lens numerical source bytes change. Before reading the flag, use GeeseFS's documented .invalidate inode-cache refresh. Only absence or unsupported xattrs receive the appropriate fallback; transport/permission errors remain failures. This was tested against fresh empty user-style touch operations on the actual volume; no canceled-token exception or ignored actual pause is used.
predata_storage_metadata_migration: Before any real new chunk rows were written, archive storage.json from v1 and update only its adapter_sha256 for the added pause guard. Prefix bytes/checksum remain identical and no chunks exist at migration.
immutable_storage_metadata: The backend returned an older adapter label even after a metadata-file update and cache refresh. No new real rank rows had been written; the identity guard stopped the worker. storage.json is now immutable prefix-creation history. Current adapter provenance lives in adapter-<source SHA256>.json, an immutable unique object name with the same frozen scientific identities/prefix checksum. A missing current-code descriptor with existing chunk data is rejected. No existing row bytes are rewritten.
queue_order: All core modules must already be complete. Reuse downloaded 3.5 first, then resume partial 3.8, then 3.6. Keep 3.6 weights/lenses for the already-authorized O-lens addendum. This changes scheduling only.
storage_error_handling: If the frozen runner catches a failure from lens_io_resume.py and no lens-completion marker exists, the wrapper returns failure so the controller stops without deleting model caches. Error files are retained and reviewed. No numerical exception or durability error is ignored.
